# VaultCore

> VaultCore is a zero-knowledge password manager for logins, payment cards, identities, secure notes, and SSH keys. Vault data is encrypted on the user's device with AES-256-GCM before it reaches the server; the server stores only ciphertext, and the master password is never transmitted.

Full reference: /llms-full.txt — product, security architecture, pricing, FAQ, and data-handling details in one document.

VaultCore is free to start and stays free: the Free plan includes one organization with two members, end-to-end encryption, a password generator, one-click browser autofill, and unlimited devices and sync. Paid plans add organizations and members.

## Plans

- Free: $0/year — 1 organization, 2 members, unlimited devices and sync
- Premium: $10/year — 2 organizations, 3 members, priority email support, advanced vault items
- Family: $49.99/year — unlimited organizations, 10 members, household sharing, family security dashboard

## Key facts

- Encryption: AES-256-GCM, end-to-end, performed on the user's device
- Member key wrapping: RSA-OAEP
- Master password: never sent to the server, never stored
- Server storage: ciphertext only
- Autofill: browser extension, one click
- Vault items: logins, cards, identities, notes, SSH keys
- Billing: yearly, in USD, cancel anytime
